value.title:
Hand in Hand × AI
— Island Mimosa Campaign
value.subtitle: AI Creative Production & Campaign

value.title: Project _Overview_
value.body:
A complete AI-generated advertising campaign for ((Hand in Hand's Foaming Shave Cream)) line — built entirely from two product reference images. Starting with nothing but the physical packaging, the entire visual world was constructed from scratch: the models, the environments, the mood, the messaging. The output is a campaign that looks and feels like a full production shoot — sunny, inclusive, and conversion-ready.

The brief was clear: captivate and convert. The answer was a tropical universe of foam, light, and joyful skin — designed to sell.

value.title: _AI Models Creation_
value.body: A diverse, inclusive cast of AI-generated models was created to reflect Hand in Hand's brand values. Each model was designed with distinct features, skin tones, and energy — a pink-haired woman mid-laugh in foam-filled light, a man confidently working the product into his face, a close-up of smooth legs in a tropical setting. Every face and body built specifically for this campaign.

value.title: _Starting Point — 2 Product Images_
value.body:
The entire campaign was generated from two source images of the physical products: the Island Mimosa (yellow) and Cactus Blossom (pink) foaming shave creams.

No existing photography. No shoot. Just the bottle — and a creative direction built around it.

value.title: _Scene & Environment Design_
value.body: Tropical backgrounds — open skies, floral flatlay surfaces, golden light — were constructed to complement the product's Island Mimosa scent story. The hero shot features an iridescent holographic product display with floating feature callouts (Moisturizing · 100% Vegan · No Parabens), creating a bold, scroll-stopping centrepiece for digital and static banner use.

value.title: _Campaign Production_
value.body:
Static and animated banner assets were produced across multiple formats for digital advertising. Each asset was designed to communicate brand values — vegan, cruelty-free, made in USA — while maintaining visual energy and warmth across the full creative suite.

**Deliverables** Static banners · Animated banners · Hero product visuals · Lifestyle campaign imagery

**Scope** Art direction · AI model creation · Scene generation · Product visualisation · Campaign production

**Brand** Hand in Hand — 100% Vegan & Cruelty Free · Made in USA
